name: Rearranging a connectable vector yields an isomorphic resultant
description: Exercise 4.85: if VSCR$ = (ZF(1),...,ZF(n)) for a permutation F of the component indices and CSCR$ = CSCR, then UISCR = UISCR$, UOSCR = UOSCR$ and RSY(SCR$) = ISY(RSY(SCR), HS, HI, HO) where PJNi(x$) = PJNF(i)(x).

elements.text: CSCR$ = CSCR, read through the renaming of tagged ports induced by F.
UISCR = UISCR$ under the renaming induced by F.
UOSCR = UOSCR$ under the renaming induced by F.
RSY(SCR$) is isomorphic to RSY(SCR) via HS(x)i = x(F(i)) and the induced renamings on external ports.
